comments.author: @cyber-security4all
comments.text: Spot-on technical analysis on Zero Trust Architecture, Half as Interesting! The underlying systems engineering: Zero Trust moves away from static perimeter firewalls toward cryptographic per-request micro-segmentation, requiring mutual TLS (mTLS), short-lived ephemeral certificates, and continuous device posture attestation before any packet touches internal microservices. Which observability tool or command do you reach for first when tracing this under real-time load? Absolute gold content! 🚀🐧

comments.text: The Audi Q3 walkthrough was the part that really landed for me — watching a $44,000 invoice turn into roughly $56,000 before taxes makes the abstract franchise-law history feel very concrete. The F&I office detail was the most eye-opening: $2,500 in gross profit per unit, from the person buyers are meant to think is just doing paperwork. And the Tesla/Scout ending reframes the whole thing — these laws now seem to protect consolidated giants like Sonic more than the small local dealers they were written for.
